ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions cover the central and mid-sections of both lobes. A thick, irregular black border follows the trailing edge. A dense black concentration at the central notch radiates outward into a speckled mottling pattern. Distal tips are marked by solid black regions with embedded high-contrast white clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central notch with an obtuse calculated angle of approximately 135-140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations are most extreme (10-20 pixels) at the distal tips, decreasing in amplitude towards the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex sweep, while the trailing edges follow a shallow concave curve extending toward the sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white pixels (barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. A single, distinct white circular cluster is located in the lower-right black-pigmented region near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-parallel vertical black linear streaks (rake marks) are detected on the left lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of vertical rake marks on the left lobe and significant barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated yellowish-brown circular pixel cluster is visible in the upper-mid section of the right lobe's white field.
